fixed: Choosing Permanently delete in Recently deleted now removes only the item you picked. Previously it also erased every other dance or program that had been in Recently deleted for more than 30 days, even if Keep recently deleted items for was set to 90 days or Never.

The Recently deleted programs screen now follows the retention setting, as the automatic cleanup already did, instead of always counting down from 30 days. The setting is now labelled Keep recently deleted items for.

added: Add an optional onlyIds filter to DanceRepository.purgeDeleted and ProgramRepository.purgeDeleted that restricts the purge to the given ids.
